invariants.rationale: The method should not return null; Option type is used instead of null for absence of value.
If an Option is present, it should wrap a non-null HoodieCleanerPlan.
Context must not be null as it is used for constructing the executor.
An Option should not be null; it should be an Option.empty() if no value is present.
The returned result must be of type Option<HoodieCleanerPlan> as per method signature.
